sources.title: Developing a CubeSat System MBSE Reference Model - Interim Status #5

evidence.supported_claim: CSRM supplies reusable space and ground logical architecture and relationships among stakeholders, requirements, architecture, measures, and use cases. Mission teams prune, extend, or replace content.
evidence.locator: `citation-2362`, pp. 2–5, CSRM, CSRM Application, and Transition sections
evidence.maturity_and_limit: Reported SysML v1 reference model. It is a tailoring basis, not a ready EPS requirements set.

evidence.supported_claim: The mission model is maintained as a central design baseline. Component power, weight, cost, and performance can roll up. Verification activities can reference plans, procedures, results, and status.
evidence.maturity_and_limit: Reported modeling pattern. The paper says power, weight, and cost parametrics had not been added to CSRM, p. 6. BOM and cost automation remain proposed.

sources.title: Integrated Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) Applied to the Simulation of a CubeSat Mission

evidence.supported_claim: SysML behavior called STK, MATLAB, and Java analyses through ModelCenter and MBSE Analyzer. Returned time histories supported solar area and battery capacity trades and mission requirement checks.
evidence.maturity_and_limit: Reported simulation proof of concept. It concentrates on energy and data, with several other subsystems simplified. It does not validate a Python or SysML v2 bridge.

sources.title: Open-Source Data Formalization through Model-Based Systems Engineering for Concurrent Preliminary Design of CubeSats

evidence.supported_claim: A Python parser extracts model data, requirements lists, and dependency graphs and can write analysis updates back. Its demonstrated parser is Gaphor specific.
evidence.maturity_and_limit: Reported software proof of concept on a theoretical academic mission. The paper identifies missing safe/off-nominal and early orbit coverage. Parser code is GPLv3.

sources.title: A Framework for sizing, designing, and testing of Electrical Power System for nanosatellites: A case study of a 3U university Cubesat

evidence.supported_claim: EPS development proceeds through mission definition, preliminary power budget, topology and component selection, and functional and environmental verification. Thermal and EMC analyses precede fabrication.
evidence.maturity_and_limit: Reported lifecycle method with one 3U hardware case. Useful procedure structure. It does not establish this framework's trace or reproduction services.

evidence.supported_claim: A mission simulation relates attitude and communication modes to solar generation, load peaks, and battery discharge. Battery sizing considers mission cycles and depth of discharge.
evidence.maturity_and_limit: Reported sizing and simulation case. Its empirical aging equation, margins, topology, and thresholds require independent applicability checks. They are not generic framework constants.

evidence.supported_claim: Battery protection is simulated in LTspice before experimental overcurrent and undervoltage/overvoltage checks. The equipment setup identifies power supply, electronic loads, multimeter, and oscilloscope.
evidence.maturity_and_limit: Reported laboratory mechanism. A simulated fault is useful for planning. It does not establish a universally safe hardware injection limit.

evidence.supported_claim: The telemetry test couples STK attitude data to an OBC, records dynamic ADCS current, and checks timestamped telemetry identities, uptime, channel currents, modes, and temperatures.
evidence.locator: `handpicked-0003`, p. 14 and Figs. 25–26 on pp. 18–19, Section 8.1.7
evidence.maturity_and_limit: Reported HIL case, external to the current project scope. Sampling and mission behavior are case specific.

evidence.supported_claim: Thermal vacuum results are reported through referenced work. EMC, radiation, and mechanical qualification tests were not performed and are future work. Data are confidential.
evidence.maturity_and_limit: Partial qualification. The conclusion's broader flight readiness wording should not conceal these explicit limits.

sources.title: Towards Intelligent Systems for Battery Management: A Five-Tier Digital Twin Architecture

evidence.supported_claim: Omniverse supplies a USD scene, semantic identities, units, coordinate frames, telemetry and simulation bindings, and read/write visualization APIs.
evidence.locator: `handpicked-0001`, pp. 3–5, Architecture Overview and Virtual 3D Environment Module
evidence.maturity_and_limit: Reported battery architecture and visualization. Transfer to CubeSat geometry and interfaces is proposed.

evidence.supported_claim: PyBaMM electrochemical and lumped thermal models are calibrated against XJTU battery data. SOH prediction and an uncertainty proxy are evaluated. The dataset includes a satellite-use profile.
evidence.maturity_and_limit: Reported dataset evaluation in a 2025 preprint. It does not demonstrate a CubeSat pack, radiation effects, safe hardware control, or the full autonomous closed loop. Its errors do not transfer to this candidate.

evidence.supported_claim: The presentation combines Python, OpenModelica, Kit extensions, FMI/FMU, and external solvers. Isaac examples include UUV battery consumption and energy tracking for a lunar robot.
evidence.maturity_and_limit: Workshop demonstration and architectural patterns. The examples are not CubeSat EPS validation.

evidence.supported_claim: USD plus FMI integration is described as an MVP and open sample proof of concept. Standard and implementation work is in progress.
evidence.maturity_and_limit: Explicitly immature integration. FMI itself and proposed USD bindings have different maturity. Compatibility and clock behavior require checks.

sources.title: Implementation of a 6U CubeSat Electrical Power System Digital Twin

evidence.supported_claim: A 6U EPS model represents solar arrays, regulators, battery, PDU, and loads. Python updates inputs. A simplified one-array/one-regulator model is compared with hardware before CHIL and PHIL demonstrations. The complete model is then used for an orbit simulation.
evidence.maturity_and_limit: Reported laboratory correlation of a simplified EPS model on Typhoon HIL. It supports an assurance sequence, not the new implementation's real-time capability.

evidence.supported_claim: The 6U model fixes battery temperature and health, simplifies switching converters and PDU loads, and omits solar and battery degradation and cell balancing.
evidence.maturity_and_limit: Explicit model limits. This source alone cannot justify coupled thermal or lifetime predictions. Replacing physical mission replicas remains a possibility.

sources.title: Model-Based Fault Detection and Diagnosis for Spacecraft with an Application for the SONATE Triple Cube Nano-Satellite

evidence.supported_claim: SONATE diagnosis compares expected behavior with telemetry. Calibration, tolerance intervals, state-dependent valid values, and conditional component mappings are required. Poor models produce false positives and negatives.
evidence.maturity_and_limit: Reported replay and manipulated qualification telemetry experiments. An apparent transceiver fault was an unmodeled external supply, pp. 25–26. Onboard use and automatic recalibration were future work.

sources.title: Architecture Framework Standardization for Satellite Software Generation Using MBSE and F Prime

evidence.supported_claim: SysML hardware and software groupings can differ. A MagicDraw plugin exports F Prime architecture, while mission functionality and command, telemetry, event, and parameter definitions need separate work in the reported workflow.
evidence.maturity_and_limit: Reported architecture generation proof of concept. It does not provide a native SysML v2 generator. Current F Prime support must be checked against a pinned release.

evidence.supported_claim: Software view products include command conditions and impacts, dictionaries, interface descriptions, software requirements, model cohesion, and V&V plans. F Prime typed connections and cFS publish-subscribe require different mappings.
evidence.maturity_and_limit: Reported framework distinctions and proposed view taxonomy. No general cross-framework code generator is validated.

sources.title: CubeSat Flight Software: Insights and a Case Study

evidence.supported_claim: The PHI-Demo software separates EPS control, telemetry collection, FDIR, and script management. Resource checks include CPU, memory, and task traces. Processor and OS choice affect power.
evidence.locator: `citation-0136`, pp. 7–9 and 12–15, Sections III.A.3, IV.A.1, V, and VI
evidence.maturity_and_limit: Reported embedded software and FlatSat case. The selected implementation is FreeRTOS based, not a validation of cFS or F Prime. Version-specific OS claims need current checking.

sources.title: Digital Twin Models for Space Robotics: Objectives, Applications, and Challenges

evidence.supported_claim: Digital thread continuity requires explicit coupling and synchronization, model validity, uncertainty, contracts, configuration control, data quality, and integration V&V. Higher fidelity increases computing and validation effort.
evidence.maturity_and_limit: Review synthesis and design principles. It establishes research gaps and mechanisms, not this framework's benefits.

sources.title: A Practical Guide to SysML, Third Edition

evidence.supported_claim: Physical architecture includes software, hardware, persistent data, and procedures. Node partitioning can follow organizational responsibility. Logical distribution precedes technology allocation.
evidence.locator: Friedenthal et al., Section 17.3.5, PDF pp. 468–480 and 486–495
evidence.maturity_and_limit: OOSEM method guidance. It permits cohosted services and procedure realizations.

authority_rules: Accepted case definitions and immutable released evidence are authoritative. CSRM is reference content.
Derived JSON, tables, USD scenes, and solver results cannot silently change the model. Reverse updates use reviewed change requests.
A run completion is distinct from a credible EPS requirement verdict. Invalid or inapplicable evidence remains unresolved.
The external facility controls physical execution authorization. No physical command path is enabled initially.
Framework verification, EPS verification and project deliverable assessment have separate subjects and acceptance records.

proposals.development: Complete the audited EPS-relevant native SysML v2 CSRM subset and requirement coaching content. Preserve source defects and modeling choices separately.
Implement stable identities, domain quantities, controlled Git/file baselines, validity and stale-evidence rules, backup, and export.
Build the small Python orchestration package, typed contracts, provenance, dependency checks, criterion evaluation, and reproduction packaging.
Integrate dynamic EPS and battery models with a CPU PyBaMM path, a simpler model, specialist tools, and one pinned FMI runtime. Establish decision-specific validity and independent correlation.
Create BOM/cost, RAM, applicability, V&V and technician-ready record templates with change propagation.
Develop separate cFS and F Prime definition profiles and flight/ground consistency checks. Demonstrate one EPS definition and nominal/fault sequence per pinned profile.
Retain OpenUSD semantic mappings, Omniverse Kit review extension, Isaac scenario adapter, and USD/FMI/EPS coupling. Activate only for decisions requiring scene or robotics evidence.
Later extend to SIL, HIL and telemetry using separate hardware, timing, safety and authorization evidence. Exclude operational control from the initial framework.
Freeze a common core and use the same correctness-first measurement protocol for contrasting cases and candidate comparison. Record actual effort, acquired costs, and uncertainties by active profile.

limitations: No source validates the combined CSRM/SysML v2/Python/Omniverse/Isaac/FMI/EPS/battery framework.
CSRM native conversion is partial. Semantic tool checks do not evaluate constraints or establish domain completeness.
Requirements learning, BOM/cost, RAM, technician plans and software definition services require proposed development and human review.

Battery dataset calibration does not establish CubeSat pack lifetime, radiation behavior, hazardous fault safety or policy effectiveness.

Native SysML v2 to cFS/F Prime export is proposed. Modern generator schemas and OS compatibility require release-specific validation. Mission behavior remains externally implemented.
Host or GPU simulations do not prove OBC CPU, memory, timing or power budgets.
Core and GPU extension resource/license costs, adoption effort, maintenance burden, reproduction effort and detection accuracy are unmeasured.
HIL, physical fault injection, flight operation, replica replacement and autonomous control are external or future scope.

common_mission_needs.moe: Correct change turnaround (elapsed hours) and active effort. On a blinded reference set report TP, FP, FN and affected-artifact accuracy against a qualified reviewer. Faster incomplete changes receive no comparative credit.

common_mission_needs.title: Maintain candidate BOMs and financial estimates
common_mission_needs.text: Maintain bills of materials and cost estimates across EPS candidate architectures and controlled design changes.
common_mission_needs.mission_requirement: The enterprise shall obtain a revision-linked BOM and financial estimate for each designated EPS candidate, with sourced prices, quantities, assumptions, uncertainty, and missing cost data visible.
common_mission_needs.moe: BOM and cost update effort (person-hours). Report differences from a reference BOM and estimate, missing priced items, and estimate uncertainty. This is separate from framework operating cost.

common_mission_needs.title: Expose early EPS design and interaction problems
common_mission_needs.text: Assess dynamic mission loads, energy shortages, thermal and EMC concerns, subsystem interactions, component choices, and controller constraints before hardware fabrication.
common_mission_needs.mission_requirement: The enterprise shall justify designated early EPS decisions using time-dependent mission and component analyses with explicit interface conditions, applicable constraints, and unsupported checks visible.
common_mission_needs.moe: Coverage of decision-relevant checks and known issues found in reference fixtures. Report analysis turnaround and effort. Physical EPS defect reduction remains an empirical outcome outside framework acceptance.

common_mission_needs.title: Establish model and policy credibility
common_mission_needs.text: Use EPS and battery models with documented calibration, validity domains, electrothermal and aging assumptions, uncertainty, and evidence appropriate to the intended decision.
common_mission_needs.mission_requirement: The enterprise shall distinguish predictions supported within a documented model validity domain from extrapolation and shall distinguish a predicted control-policy benefit from a demonstrated hardware benefit.
common_mission_needs.moe: Intended decisions covered by applicable model evidence. Report voltage, temperature, energy, health or lifetime residuals in their own units, uncertainty, runtime, and parameter-update delay. Limits require agreement for each intended use.

common_mission_needs.title: Support RAM requirement coverage and analysis
common_mission_needs.text: Identify RAM variables in requirements and generate reusable RAM analysis models from the evolving EPS and spacecraft design.
common_mission_needs.mission_requirement: The enterprise shall relate designated RAM claims to requirements, design failure dependencies, generated analysis models, input assumptions, and verification evidence or explicit gaps.
common_mission_needs.moe: RAM model preparation effort and coverage of the declared failure and requirement set. Report model generation differences from an expert reference. No framework verdict establishes achieved spacecraft RAM.

common_mission_needs.title: Prepare feasible, safe and informative verification
common_mission_needs.text: Define EPS and component verification activities with usable procedures, conditions, equipment and DUT interfaces, safety information, observable variables, and valid synchronized telemetry.
common_mission_needs.mission_requirement: The enterprise shall provide a reviewable verification proposal and evidence contract for each designated activity, with feasibility and safety decisions reserved to the responsible engineers and testing facility.
common_mission_needs.moe: Proposal preparation and technician clarification effort. Report missing proposal fields, evidence completeness, invalid samples, and synchronization uncertainty. Physical fault limits and timing tolerances require facility agreement.

common_mission_needs.title: Engineer consistent EPS flight and ground software integration
common_mission_needs.text: Keep command, telemetry, event, parameter, mode and recovery definitions consistent with EPS hardware and support cFS and F-Prime mappings and target resource assessment.
common_mission_needs.mission_requirement: The enterprise shall produce revision-linked EPS software integration contracts, framework-specific mappings, command and mode checks, and processor, memory, timing and power evidence for the declared target configuration.
common_mission_needs.moe: Interface discrepancy detection and integration effort on common reference fixtures. Report dictionary and behavior coverage, configuration compatibility status, and target resource estimates or measurements. Unverified target deployment stays explicit.

common_mission_needs.title: Reproduce and reuse evidence for analysis and troubleshooting
common_mission_needs.text: Enable independent reproduction and reuse of early EPS analysis and later supplied measurements without losing configuration or validity context.
common_mission_needs.mission_requirement: The enterprise shall permit an independent participant to reconstruct each designated analysis from its controlled baseline and evaluate agreement using result-specific comparison rules fixed before execution.
common_mission_needs.moe: Successful designated reproductions / attempted designated reproductions, independent active effort, and reconstruction gaps. Agreement limits are result-specific. Reduced use of physical replicas is a future hypothesis.

common_mission_needs.title: Communicate designs and justification clearly
common_mission_needs.text: Provide readable design views and requirement-to-design-to-evidence reviews with visible assumptions, limitations, and finding dispositions.
common_mission_needs.mission_requirement: The enterprise shall provide a controlled review package from which a reviewer can locate the designated design, decision rationale, applicable evidence, and unresolved findings.
common_mission_needs.moe: Review preparation effort and reviewer task completion, interpretation accuracy, and clarification effort on a fixed task set. Readability needs a reviewer protocol, not an invented visual score.

common_mission_needs.title: Adopt and reuse the framework within team resources
common_mission_needs.text: Provide a declared minimum environment, learning path and reusable core suitable for contrasting EPS contexts, with adoption, adaptation and direct operating burdens visible.
common_mission_needs.mission_requirement: The enterprise shall complete the declared reference workflow in two contrasting EPS cases using an identified common core, declared case adaptations, and independently reconstructable environment instructions.
common_mission_needs.moe: Adoption and case adaptation effort (active person-hours), direct framework cost (CAD over a declared period), and case completion status. Report required computing, licenses and services. Resource ceilings require stakeholder agreement.

common_framework_requirements.title: Requirement record
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall retain each requirement as an identified record with source need, parent, rationale, observable quantities or conditions and applicable units, owner, verification method, criterion, and resolution status.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: A complete fixture round-trips these fields. An absent criterion is reported as unresolved and cannot acquire a verified label.
common_framework_requirements.record_rule: A not-applicable field retains a rationale. Qualitative and demonstration-based requirements are allowed.

common_framework_requirements.title: Learning and templates
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall provide requirement and traceability templates, worked EPS examples, and a guided reference workflow that covers writing criteria, linking evidence, and interpreting gaps.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Inspect the learning package and demonstrate the workflow from a declared clean start. Measure learner effort and errors without imposing an unagreed time limit.

common_framework_requirements.title: Method applicability
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall retain a source-linked catalogue of requirement derivation and verification methods, standards, and activity templates with applicability, tailoring rationale, and limitations.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: For subsystem and component fixtures retrieve the chosen method and its source, conditions, tailoring decision, and excluded alternatives. A catalogue entry does not assert standards compliance.

common_framework_requirements.title: Bidirectional trace retrieval
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall retrieve applicable links from needs and requirements to design decisions, model inputs, verification criteria and results, and retrieve the reverse paths.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Compare both query directions with the fixture relation set. Missing, ambiguous and stale endpoints remain visible.

common_framework_requirements.title: Change impact
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall identify the requirements, EPS and non-EPS allocations, BOMs, models, software definitions, procedures, and evidence affected by a designated change.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Use seeded cross-subsystem and component changes. Compare the returned impact set and unresolved coverage with an adjudicated reference.

common_framework_requirements.title: Change disposition
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall issue a successor baseline for an accepted change that retains its request and failed-gate context and marks affected evidence as regenerated, stale, or unresolved.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Exercise a failed verification gate followed by correction. Preserve the prior baseline and prevent stale results from appearing current.

common_framework_requirements.title: Controlled baselines
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall retain identified, retrievable baselines of engineering records, case configuration, and evidence with revision history and distinct identities for accepted successors.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Reconstruct two revisions after a change and compare their manifests and contents. Attempted overwrite cannot erase the retained prior baseline.

common_framework_requirements.title: Semantic transfers
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall check transferred identifiers, structure, quantities, units, polarity, time bases, interface meanings, and provenance against a declared contract and retain explicit rejection findings.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Inject unit, sign, identifier and time-base mismatches. Reject incompatible transfers without replacing controlled content. Record unsupported or lossy mappings.

common_framework_requirements.title: Result provenance
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall associate each result with its producer, method, requirement and decision, design and hardware configuration, software and model versions, parameter set, input data, environment, and raw output.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Trace an analytical and a supplied measurement result to every applicable configuration item. An unknown identity remains a gap and blocks a contradictory validity claim.

common_framework_requirements.title: Independent replay
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall provide controlled instructions and dependencies to reconstruct and execute a designated analysis and compare its raw outputs using declared result-specific rules and tolerances.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: An independent participant replays a baseline from a clean declared environment. Retain logs, seeds when relevant, failures and comparison verdicts. Tolerances are fixed before replay.

common_framework_requirements.title: Evidence and discrepancy status
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall report missing, rejected, stale, out-of-domain, failed, and unresolved evidence with its affected claim, criticality rationale, owner and disposition.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Seed each status including a critical finding. A claim affected by unresolved critical evidence cannot receive an unqualified supported or verified status.

common_framework_requirements.title: Candidate BOM
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall generate and revise a candidate-specific BOM from identified physical design items with assembly, quantities, part identifiers, variant and selection status, and source revision.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Compare two alternative assemblies and one component substitution with a reference BOM. Candidate alternatives remain distinct. Missing part data is reported.

common_framework_requirements.title: Financial estimate
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall derive a revision-linked financial estimate from the BOM and declared additional cost categories while retaining price source, date, currency, quantity, estimate basis, uncertainty and missing data.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Recalculate a sourced-price fixture after a quantity and part change. Match reference arithmetic and preserve unknown costs. Do not import historical project costs as new framework measurements.

common_framework_requirements.title: EPS candidate comparison
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall produce a comparison of designated EPS architectures using a common requirement, assumption, evidence and criterion basis with feasibility status, raw measures, uncertainty and decision rationale.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Compare candidates with a failing requirement and incomplete evidence. Keep feasibility and unknown status separate from ranking. Any preference weights are declared before results.

common_framework_requirements.title: Reusable EPS representation
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall provide a configurable generic EPS representation covering requirements, functions, logical and physical elements, interfaces, modes and states, with case-specific parameter and extension records.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Instantiate the representation in two contrasting cases and trace a requirement through function, allocation, interface and analysis. An extension retains its relation to the generic core.

common_framework_requirements.title: Dynamic mission composition
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall compose time-dependent subsystem demand, duty cycles, schedules and mode transitions with orbit, attitude, irradiance, eclipse, thermal conditions and EPS supply and protection behavior.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Use a fixture whose average budget passes while a coupled load and illumination event creates a transient shortage. Inspect inputs, interactions and event timing against a reference calculation.

common_framework_requirements.title: Requirement parameter derivation
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall record how sourced component power and thermal characteristics and subsystem behavior become EPS or component requirement parameters, including units, uncertainties, allowable ranges and criterion decisions.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Derive a fixture allocation from datasheet and supplied measurement inputs using a declared method. Preserve assumptions and flag unsupported ranges and undecided pass/fail values.

common_framework_requirements.title: Discipline model integration
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall exchange identified EPS component and design data with declared electrical, thermal, EMC and CAD analysis tools and retain model mappings, applicable outputs and unsupported checks.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Every electrical, thermal, EMC and CAD exchange profile required by the frozen minimum shall complete its reference request/result exchange and declared identity, quantity, unit, meaning and revision checks. Retain unsupported mappings and development gaps. A missing required profile remains not verified or undetermined and cannot pass V18. A narrower minimum requires a reviewed scope disposition before evaluation.

common_framework_requirements.title: Early verification scenarios
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall execute or coordinate declared virtual EPS and component verification scenarios for dynamic loads, supply changes, protection events, rare faults, and controller electrical and timing constraints.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Retain stimulus, conditions, expected response, outputs and status for nominal and failure fixtures. Unsupported behavior and physical validation needs are explicit, including COTS evidence gaps.

common_framework_requirements.title: Battery model coupling
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall integrate identified battery electrical, thermal and degradation models with mission loads and retain the states, health and lifetime outputs, assumptions and uncertainty supported by each model.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Replay fresh and aged battery fixtures under different load and temperature profiles. Verify coupling and provenance. Missing aging mechanisms and latent-state uncertainty remain visible.

common_framework_requirements.title: Intended-use credibility
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall associate each analytical verification claim with the model intended use, tested validity domain, calibration and validation evidence, uncertainty and acceptable prediction-error rule.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Exercise an in-domain and an extrapolated claim. Separate calibration from validation data where available. Flag untested domains and absent error limits. Prediction accuracy limits require prior agreement.

common_framework_requirements.title: Model update workflow
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall use supplied measurements to create an identified calibration or parameter-update record with data quality, prior and revised parameters, residuals and affected analyses.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Apply a measurement fixture, compare the declared calibration result with a reference, retain both parameter revisions, and flag analyses affected by drift or update.

common_framework_requirements.title: Fidelity and execution contract
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall record the selected model fidelity, execution environment, time step, measured or estimated runtime and interface delays for each declared SIL or HIL interaction profile.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Profile a declared executable model and replay timestamped input/output fixtures. Real-time suitability remains unresolved until the applicable hardware and deadline are verified.

common_framework_requirements.title: Controller policy assessment
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall compare designated charging and power-management policies under declared load, thermal, health, electrical and timing conditions with safety constraints and policy-specific outcome evidence.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Replay a baseline and a changed policy against the same fixture conditions. A model prediction cannot be labeled a demonstrated hardware improvement. Retain pending SIL, HIL or hardware evidence.

common_framework_requirements.title: Anomaly assessment
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall compare time-correlated EPS telemetry with modeled expected behavior while retaining operating mode, model validity, degradation and sensor uncertainty, and alternative fault explanations.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Use nominal, degrading, noisy and injected-fault fixtures. Retain residuals and diagnoses with TP, FP and FN against an expert reference. No pre-threshold detection capability is presumed.

common_framework_requirements.title: RAM requirement coverage
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall identify the RAM variables and failure assumptions applicable to designated EPS and spacecraft requirements and report their verification-method coverage and gaps.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Compare the declared RAM variable and requirement set with a reference. Report analysis, inspection, demonstration or test rationale without forcing every claim to use analysis.

common_framework_requirements.title: RAM model generation
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall generate a declared RAM analysis representation from identified functions, components and failure dependencies with traceable transformation rules and sourced or missing reliability data.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Generate an FMEA, fault tree or other justified representation for a reference design and its changed variant. Compare entities and dependencies with an expert model. Missing probabilities cannot become factual reliability estimates.

common_framework_requirements.title: Verification activity record
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall retain each EPS or component verification activity with requirement, method, DUT baseline, applicable quantities or observable conditions, inputs, expected response, criterion, evidence variables and status. An inapplicable field shall retain its rationale.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Inspect quantitative analysis/test and qualitative inspection/demonstration fixtures against their method-specific fields. Check the applicable quantity or observable condition, criterion, expected response and evidence. An inapplicable field retains rationale. Missing mandatory fields, failed gates and unresolved criteria remain explicit and prevent an unsupported verdict.

common_framework_requirements.title: Facility proposal
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall produce a technician-readable verification proposal that specifies conditions, equipment and fixture identities, DUT connections, stimulus sequence, observations and evidence-generation procedure.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: A technician or qualified proxy checks a fixture proposal against a declared completeness checklist and identifies how equipment interacts with the DUT. Facility feasibility remains a separate decision.

common_framework_requirements.title: Safety declaration
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall include hazards, battery and electronics operating limits, fault-injection envelope, isolation, abort conditions and responsible safety-review status in each proposed physical verification activity.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Use a safe virtual fault fixture and an incomplete physical proposal. Missing limits or approval status block a ready-for-physical-execution label. The framework does not authorize laboratory operations.

common_framework_requirements.title: Evidence timing
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall record the time base, sampling and synchronization rules and known measurement, calculation and output delays for applied stimuli, responses and telemetry.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Align a known timestamp fixture and expose injected skew and missing timing metadata. Report alignment error or uncertainty against the agreed profile, with no invented global limit.

common_framework_requirements.title: Telemetry quality
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall check expected telemetry channels, units, timestamps, completeness and sensor validity conditions and preserve raw samples, invalid values and processing masks.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Inject missing samples, inactive sensors and invalid values. Do not treat inactive invalid readings as valid measurements. Match the fixture quality verdict and retained raw data.

common_framework_requirements.title: Shared software definitions
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall retain revision-linked EPS command, telemetry, event and parameter definitions with identifiers, types, units, ranges and encodings mapped to hardware, functional software and ground dictionaries.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Compare model, flight and ground fixtures against a shared contract. Detect a changed definition in one representation and report every affected mapping.

common_framework_requirements.title: Flight framework mapping
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall produce or coordinate checked mappings of the EPS software contract to declared cFS software-bus and F-Prime typed-connection profiles and identify behavior and implementation gaps.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Round-trip or validate reference message and port mappings in both profiles. Declare framework version and unsupported exports. Architecture or dictionary generation is distinct from mission-specific functionality.

common_framework_requirements.title: Command and recovery contract
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall specify and check EPS command preconditions, order, expected effects, rejection and failure behavior, mode transitions and recovery responsibilities across EPS, telemetry, fault-management and safe-mode functions.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Replay nominal, rejected and recovery sequences with a qualified software reference. Confirm functional flow and ownership without claiming deployment of flight software.

common_framework_requirements.title: Target integration assessment
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall retain a versioned OBC, operating-system, flight-framework and toolchain configuration with compatibility evidence and processor, memory, timing and power budget evidence for EPS functions.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Inspect a build/deployment profile and reference resource records. Distinguish measurements, estimates and unknown target compatibility. Check against mission-supplied allocations when available.

common_framework_requirements.title: Readable design views
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall produce filtered context, structure, interface and selected-design views from controlled EPS records with identifiers, units, legends and links to the represented baseline.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Compare generated views with a fixture model and apply a declared reviewer task checklist. Assess correctness and readability without proliferating requirement, measure, scenario or state diagrams.

common_framework_requirements.title: Review package
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall assemble the designated requirement, decision, design, evidence, assumptions, uncertainty, validity limits, findings and dispositions into a baseline-linked review package.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: An independent reviewer locates the designated claims and evidence and records findings and outcomes. Keep author status, reviewer outcome and approval authority distinct.

common_framework_requirements.title: Minimum adoption and measurement package
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall declare prerequisites, resource footprint, licenses, dependencies and learning instructions for its minimum workflow and record adoption, adaptation, change, reproduction and direct-cost observations under one evaluation protocol.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Demonstrate the minimum workflow from a clean declared environment. Record wall-clock time separately from active person-hours and state the cost period and inclusions. Unknown cost stays unknown.

common_framework_requirements.title: Contrasting-case reuse
common_framework_requirements.text: The framework shall apply an identified common core to two predefined contrasting EPS cases using declared parameters, mappings and extensions and retain case outcomes and any core changes.
common_framework_requirements.proposed_acceptance: Complete the same declared workflow in both cases without undeclared or post hoc core changes. If the core changes, rebaseline and rerun both cases before a reuse claim. No implementation or successful outcome is asserted here.
